test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**capable**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the ability of frogs to live both in water and on land.
 
• The most suitable adjective should describe the frogs' ability to thrive in both environments.
 
• **"Capable"** fits well because it directly refers to the frogs' ability to live in both water and on land.
 
• Other options such as "susceptible," "dispose," and "incline" do not fit the context of describing the frogs' abilities.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Susceptible"** refers to being prone or vulnerable to something, which does not describe the frogs' ability to live in different environments.
 
• **"Dispose" **refers to getting rid of something, which is not relevant in the context of frogs' capability.
 
• **"Incline" **refers to a tendency or preference, which does not fit the context of frogs living in both environments.
